related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

request.operation: read the selected campaign evidence page and a bounded session-event page
request.pre_change_readback_status: observed during this session before the cursor-preservation change; the CLI output was not persisted as an artifact

outcome.interpretation: The compact activity preserved the next event sequence but omitted the requested page limit and explicit first-page cursor. The bounded event window could not be reconstructed from the returned source metadata alone.
outcome.scope_limit: This is one selected-session projection readback. The response was truncated and three observation records were compacted out; it does not establish that records were lost from the campaign ledger.

pressure_hypothesis.title: ECI response compaction omits bounded session-event page parameters
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve the requested event window limit, explicit page cursor, and next cursor through ordinary and response-budget compaction while keeping response and event reads bounded.

not_measured: The number of additional agent operations required by the missing cursor metadata.
